statement: ∀ n p q : ℕ, 0 < n → n ≤ p+q → p+q < 2*n → (n ∣ p+q ↔ p+q=n)

plain_statement.zh: 在无混叠窗口中从碰撞恢复精确和
plain_statement.en: Recover an exact sum from a collision in an alias-free window

brief.zh: 把反向运动写成 p 与 −q 的相位差。窗口排除零倍和二倍目标。
brief.en: Opposite motion gives the phase difference p+q. The window excludes the zero and double multiples.
